# as WKT

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:asWKT`](gmeow-asWKT.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/asWKT>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A Well-Known Text (WKT) serialization of a geometry. The range is [rdfs:Literal](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) (not [geo:wktLiteral](http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral)) to stay within the OWL 2 DL datatype map; data may still tag the literal ^^[geo:wktLiteral](http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral), and the alignment to [geo:asWKT](http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#asWKT) preserves GeoSPARQL semantics for spatial engines.
